item.title: Anthropic replaced git with its own source control: Scion
item.description: Anthropic doesn’t use git for its monorepo anymore. In five months they moved to their own version control system called Scion, and the reason is simple: agents write too much code for git to keep up. The numbers In May 2026 about 2,500 changes a day were merged into Anthropic’s monorepo. By September it was over 30,000. Most of that growth comes from Claude writing code, not from people. At that scale the repository itself becomes the problem:
